## And
Southern Power Distribution Company of Andhra Pradesh Limited, a company
incorporated under the Companies Act 1956 or the Companies Act 2013 as applicable,
having its registered office at Kesavayanagunta, Tiruchanoor Road, Tirupati,
Andhra Pradesh -517501,India (hereinafter referred to as “[APSPDCL]”, or “Buying
Utility”, which expression shall, unless repugnant to the context or meaning thereof, be
deemed to include its successors and permitted assignees) as a Party of the second part.
SECI and APDISCOMs are individually referred to as ‘Party’ and collectively referred to
as ‘Parties’.
## Whereas:
1. A. SECI has been identified by the Government of India as the implementing
2. agency for purchase and sale of grid connected Solar PV power at 33 kV or
3. above under Phase –II, Batch- III of the Jawaharlal Nehru National Solar
4. Mission of Government of India (GoI).
5. B. SECI will sign Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) and VGF Securitization
6. Agreements (VGFSAs) with the selected solar power developers
7. (hereinafter referred to as “SPDs”) for procurement of 500 MW Solar Power
8. or the total capacity of projects selected under the provisions of RfS
9. (SECI/JNNSM/P-2/B-3/AP/122015 dated 02.01.2016), if it is less than 500
10. MW, on a long term basis, as indicated at Schedule-1 and Schedule-2
11. respectively.
12. C. SECI has agreed to sell Solar Power to the APDISCOMs and the
13. APDISCOMs have agreed to purchase such Solar Power from SECI as per
14. the terms and conditions of this Agreement.
15. D. SECI has agreed to sell power to the Buying Utilities at the tariff determined
16. from the reverse auction process mentioned in the RfS plus trading margin
17. of Rs. 0.07/kWh i.e. Rs.4.5/Kwh fixed for entire term of this Agreement.
18. E. The Parties hereby agree to execute this Power Sale Agreement setting out
19. the terms and conditions for the sale of Solar Power up to the agreed
20. Contracted Capacity by SECI to the Buying Utility.
21. F. The agreed Contracted Capacity by SECI to the APDISCOMs shall be
22. [500MW] or the total capacity of projects selected under the provisions of
23. RfS (SECI/JNNSM/P-2/B-3/AP/122015 dated 02.01.2016), if it is less than
24. 500MW, as per the allocation letter issued by SECI. The agreed contracted
25. capacity by SECI shall be allocated to the APDISCOMs as per the
26. directions of GoAP from time to time.
NOW THEREFORE, IN CONSIDERATION OF THE PREMISES AND MUTUAL
AGREEMENTS, COVENANTS AND CONDITIONS SET FORTH HEREIN, IT IS HEREBY
AGREED BY AND BETWEEN THE PARTIES AS FOLLOWS:

*pe*
Chief General Manager
P&MM&IPC,
A.P.S.P.D.C.L., Tirupathi
